--- sys/net/ble/bluetil/bluetil_addr/bluetil_addr.c
+++ sys/net/ble/bluetil/bluetil_addr/bluetil_addr.c
@@ -90,7 +90,15 @@
 
 void bluetil_addr_ipv6_l2ll_sprint(char *out, const uint8_t *addr)
 {
-    /* MASKED - implement this function */
+    assert(out);
+    assert(addr);
+
+    /* Build IPv6 link-local address from 48-bit BLE address per RFC 4291:
+     * the EUI-64 IID is formed by inserting 0xfffe between bytes 2 and 3,
+     * and flipping the universal/local bit (bit 1 of the first byte). */
+    sprintf(out, "fe80::%02x%02x:%02xff:fe%02x:%02x%02x",
+            addr[0] ^ 0x02, addr[1], addr[2],
+            addr[3], addr[4], addr[5]);
 }
 
 void bluetil_addr_ipv6_l2ll_print(const uint8_t *addr)
